commits: daemon: record pane pid and start ticks on every locator (state v24)
daemon: trust a pane only as the process its locator recorded
docs(daemon): a root is trusted only as the process its locator recorded
trickyParts: Identity is read INSIDE launchShimmedProcess's per-issue serialize lane, not after it: the in-memory issue->window map (`issueWindows`, formerly `issueWindowIds`) now stores the opened pane's full locator (window id + pane id + pid + start ticks). `recordedLocatorsInWindow` includes that entry, so a concurrent second spawn on the same issue (queued behind the first launch) can verify the first pane by identity and split into its window; with the plan's original 'read identity after the lane' shape the existing test 'serializes two concurrent first spawns on the same issue into a single new window' opened two windows because the first launch's claim was not yet persisted when the second probed.

Amendment A implemented: controllerAlive on any non-verified verdict other than pane-gone logs both identities, then runs stopProcess(controllerToken, locator, workerStopTimeoutMs) in a try/catch (graceful shutdown over the controller's per-role socket; kill-pane gated by the same identity verdict) before deleting controllerLocator. Test 'ensureController gracefully stops, never kills, a controller locator whose pane id was reissued...' asserts the shutdown reached the controller socket, no kill-pane, fresh `new-window controller`.

Sweep rules applied (Task 4). Rule (a) seeded identity: closeTree/graceful-stop tests (livePanes(command, 4242) -> livePanes(command) so tree()'s recorded pid 12345 verifies), controller registration-deadline tests (`...paneIdentity()` on seeded controller locators; launched controller `toEqual` gained panePid/paneStartTicks), dead-socket respawn tests (`...paneIdentity()`/`paneIdentity(22222)` on the stale worker + list-panes reporting it), root registration-deadline tests (a `launchedPids` Map so list-panes answers each launched pane with its own `1000N`/`8765N` pid). Rule (c) applied to 'clears completed-tree phases ... shuts down its recorded tmux tree' and 'treats a kill-pane that finds no server...': list-panes now reports the recorded identity and connectWorkerRpc refuses so the kill IS attempted and PANE_GONE_STDERR stays covered; no kill-pane-presence assertion was dropped. Rule (b): the backfill test was deleted (replaced by the legacy-locator test).

One pre-existing assertion was strengthened rather than weakened: 'retires the pane instead of writing a claim when closeTree closes the tree while a launch is still in flight' previously passed only because the ROOT's dead-looking pane got killed (any kill-pane counted); it now makes the tester's shim refuse and asserts `kill-pane -t %1` for the just-opened tester pane specifically.

index.test.ts (startDaemon) and processes.thermo-ops.test.ts construct their own deps without `readProcessStat`, so the real /proc/12345/stat read made every launch a launch failure. `DaemonDependencies` gained `readProcessStat?` (passed through exactly like readProcessCmdline) and both fixtures inject a fake stat line (`fakeProcStat` in index.test.ts, inline in thermo-ops).

The LEGION_TMUX_LIVE=1 gated test 'probes a real tmux pane as alive, detects its death, and resurrects it once' now uses the REAL /proc read (`readProcessStat: undefined`) and asserts the recorded paneStartTicks equals parseProcStatStartTicks(readFile('/proc/<panePid>/stat')). Ran green locally with LEGION_TMUX_LIVE=1 on a throwaway `legion-smoke<ts>` server.

Log assertions follow amendment B: tests assert both identities appear (observed pid, 'recorded pid N start M') and, for the legacy case, /no recorded process identity/; nothing pins 'not killing pane'. The watchdog 'never re-armed' contract is asserted as retirement within the first fake-clock interval (currentTime advanced < 2000ms) plus locator cleared / launchFailures 1 / queued, not via log-absence.

Pre-existing tick-bounded waits (flushEventLoopUntil against real fs I/O) are load-sensitive: in one 4-file run under load three older tests failed on tick exhaustion and passed on every other run (40/40 alone on both the pre-change baseline copy and the new code); one full-package run had an unrelated flake in instance-lock.test.ts ('resolves exactly one winner when contenders race a stale lock'), green on the next run. No test I touched depends on new fs I/O (the fixture's readProcessStat is synchronous).

CI red at 0a4dc25f (run 34718138952, `test` job): two `LEGION_E2E=1`-gated tests in real-shutdown-e2e.test.ts failed -- `kills a real pane wrapping a real worker-shim after its stop timeout...` and `lets a root's own self-report POST to /process/exit resolve...` -- both on `expect(await waitForPaneGone(paneId)).toBe(false)` (pane still alive). Root cause: that file seeds worker/root locators by hand from a REAL tmux pane without `panePid`/`paneStartTicks`; under the new contract an identity-less locator never verifies, so `stopProcess` treated the pane as already gone (log: `not killing pane %1 ... no recorded process identity`) and never killed it. Classification: a pre-existing fixture in a file I had not touched that needs rule (a) -- and a verification gap on my side: CI sets LEGION_E2E=1 and LEGION_TMUX_LIVE=1 and I had only run the latter locally. Fix: `openShimWindow` now captures `#{pane_pid}` from `new-window -P -F` and reads the real `/proc/<pid>/stat` through `parseProcStatStartTicks`, returning a full `WorkerLocator` (identity required in its type) that both tests seed verbatim -- the same identity `launchShimmedProcess` records. Added one real-tmux negative control in the same file: the same live pane recorded with start ticks off by one is never killed (no `kill-pane`), its claim clears, the tree closes, the pane survives; the daemon log carries both identities. Proof: `LEGION_E2E=1 LEGION_TMUX_LIVE=1 bun test real-shutdown-e2e.test.ts` 4/4 green 5x in a row (and 5x more after a type tightening), 4/4 while processes+api and processes+index suites ran concurrently, and the whole daemon package under the exact CI env 898 pass / 0 fail / 0 skip with two other suites running alongside.

Corrective round from the tester's .legion/test.json audit (tests + one doc sentence, no src change). (1) Restored `expect(managedState.trees[root]?.status).toBe("closed")` in the in-flight-launch closeTree test -- its deletion had been an unnecessary weakening. (2) The two reissued-pane registration-deadline tests (T2b and its spawnRoot sibling) no longer wait on the shared tick-bounded `flushEventLoopUntil(..., 20_000)` (~23 ms of setImmediate ticks racing spawnRoot's real workspace/secret-file writes; the tester saw 2/6 isolated failures): `reissuablePanes` now also supplies a `saveState` whose `resurrected` promise settles on the save that records the resurrected generation's fresh locator (generation N, status active, locator pid == the pid the fake tmux handed that pane), and the tests await that event. Evidence: 30/30 isolated runs of the reconnectRoots test, 30/30 of its sibling, and 30/30 of the reconnectRoots test while two other suites ran concurrently; full processes.test.ts 205/205. The same tick-bounded pattern remains in the pre-existing deadline tests this change did not author (~4181, ~4243, ~4567, ~4954, ~5049 and the controller-deadline group) -- unchanged this round per the architect's five-item scope. (3) The controller reissued-pane test is now two siblings over one fixture: the identity-gate case makes the recorded controller's socket refuse (ECONNREFUSED) so `stopProcess` skips the graceful branch and only the identity gate stands before `kill-pane` -- asserts no kill-pane, fresh `new-window controller`, fresh locator, both identities logged; the graceful sibling keeps the shutdown-over-own-socket coverage. (4) The it.each cases each carry an `observed` regex -- /pid 777/, /pid 12345 .*999999/ (the observed start ticks), /pid 12345 .*\/proc/ (unreadable /proc) -- so the log check discriminates from the shared `recorded pid 12345 start 4242` half. (5) AGENTS.md watchdog bullet: `Only a boot whose pane is gone -- or present but no longer running the process its locator recorded -- *and* whose socket refuses a connection is retired`. Package under the CI env: 899 pass / 0 fail.

Review round (CHANGES_REQUESTED 5188293250), both blocking findings from a legacy no-identity verdict being read as not-our-process where our own live process is what is there. B1 (r3997829564): `rewriteIssueWindowId` repointed live legacy locators (workers on resurrect; the root on spawn_worker) to the fresh window, so their real window fell out of `knownWindows` and the sweep kill-windowed it. Fix per architect direction (reviewer option a): a locator's `tmuxWindowId` is never rewritten; `probedWindowId` now iterates `recordedLocators(issue)` (root locator if root, each worker claim's locator, the in-memory `issueWindows` entry, in that preference order) and returns the first window whose pane verifies, else `undefined` (dropping the stale in-memory entry); `launchShimmedProcess` records a fresh window in `issueWindows` alone; `rewriteIssueWindowId`/`recordedWindowId`/`recordedLocatorsInWindow` deleted. Regression tests: `legacyLiveTreeFixture` (live, identity-less root %0 in @42 [+ implementer %3], fake list-windows reporting @42/@43 owned with activity 0) drives both repros: probe->resurrect->reconcileTmuxWindows(0) and spawnWorker(tester)->spawnWorker(planner)->reconcile; assert the legacy locators keep `@42`, the fresh worker lands in `@43`, the next worker splits into `@43`, and no kill-window/kill-pane at all. The pre-existing test pinning the rewrite was rewritten to the new contract (stale claims keep their dead window; later workers split into the fresh one). B2 (r3997829566): `closeTreeLocked` derived `skipGraceful` from `probe()`, which reports a legacy locator dead without touching tmux, so a live legacy root was never sent `shutdown`. Fix: `closeTreeLocked` takes the `verifyPaneProcess` verdict itself and passes `skipGraceful` only for `pane-gone`; regression test asserts the shutdown frame reaches `/state/workers/architect.sock`, no kill-pane, tree closed, locator cleared. Non-blocking (r3997829569): `samePaneIdentity(current, stopped)` (pane id + panePid + paneStartTicks) replaces the pane-id-only comparisons in `markWorkerDeadLocked`, `retireUnconfirmedBoot`, and closeTree's delete guard (which now snapshots the stopped locator by value). Fast-follow items all landed: `tmux.panePid(server, paneId)` lost its window-id `rows[0]` branch and doc sentence (tmux.test.ts:30 deleted); both docs/solutions notes rewritten to the pane-id-only probe with the removed `firstPaneId`/`windowAlive` named only as history; triple logging collapsed to one line per decision -- `resurrectDeadTree` guards silently via `verifyPaneProcess` and hands its verdict to `removeTreeWindow` -> `stopProcess({ refused })`, `controllerAlive` passes `{ refused: verdict }`, and `stopProcess`'s gate logs only a refusal it decided itself (a verified verdict is never accepted as `refused`; the pane is always re-verified at kill time) -- verified with a throwaway counting identity lines: root probe->resurrect 1, closeTree 1 per pane, controller 1; the undiscriminating watchdog test (`paneProcessVerified: () => false` cannot tell reissued from gone) deleted, acceptance 7 stays on the ProcessManager-level test; `/%1/` in the tree-close gate test became `/%1[^\n]*pid 777/`; the `Errors row 3` comments now describe the behaviour. AGENTS.md worker bullet: a later worker splits into a recorded window only while some recorded pane in it verifies, else a fresh window; a locator's tmuxWindowId is never rewritten. Daemon package under LEGION_E2E=1 LEGION_TMUX_LIVE=1: 900 pass / 0 fail.
deviations: Plan T2b asserted the second `new-window` carries `--resume=` for a root whose registration deadline elapses on a reissued pane. A root that never reached /process/started has no ompSessionFile, so that resurrect is a fresh start exactly as the mirrored pre-existing test ('resurrects directly, once, when the root registration deadline elapses on a dead pane') already is; the --resume assertion lives in the sibling reconnectRoots test, whose seeded locator carries a real session file.

Plan's `issueWindowIds: Map<IssueKey, string>` kept as-is would have broken concurrent same-issue first spawns (see trickyParts); it became `issueWindows: Map<IssueKey, PaneLocator>` and identity is read inside the launch lane. Same contract (a recorded window is reused only when a recorded pane in it verifies), one more recorded pane source.
Plan T5 asserted the literal phrase /not killing pane %1/; per the architect's amendment B the test asserts /%1/, /pid 777/, /recorded pid 12345 start 4242/ instead.
Two additional test files outside the plan's fileMap needed the readProcessStat seam (index.test.ts, processes.thermo-ops.test.ts) plus a two-line pass-through in daemon/index.ts.
